mostWorthwhile.text: Following fragments from a destructive collision into the growing rocky world was most worthwhile: it connected breakage with later growth rather than treating them as opposites.

leastWorthwhile.text: The outer-body sequence felt repetitive after the rocky swarm's collapse, with only one combination offered at each decision.

surprise.text: The rocky swarm formed a population of separate bodies through gravitational collapse rather than simply sticking into one object.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly purposeless, although the fast-mode menu supplied compatible combinations rather than letting me discover them.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the large icy body's mass affects its encounter with disk gas, though the parallel formation sequences were becoming predictable.
